scene_prompt: Low angle view of a curvy Latina woman with long dark wavy hair loose over her shoulders and sharp dark eyes. She reclines on a cream velvet sofa in a penthouse living room, legs draped lazily over one arm, one hand holding a red wine glass by the stem resting against her stomach, wearing a black lace bodysuit under an open black silk robe. City lights glowing through floor-to-ceiling windows behind her, a single amber floor lamp casting warm light across her body. Shot on a Contax T2, Kodak Ektar 100, 38mm f/2.8, shallow depth of field, soft halation from the city glow. Keep her face, hair, and body exactly the same.
video_prompt: Low angle view. 0-2s: She reclines completely still, wine glass resting on her stomach, one finger tracing the rim slowly — city lights pulse softly through the window behind her. 2-5s: She lifts the glass deliberately to her lips, takes a slow sip, her eyes sliding to the camera over the rim as she does it. 5-8s: She lowers the glass and says, commanding: 'sit down. you're blocking my view.' 8-10s: She turns her gaze back to the window — completely unbothered, the city glowing behind her. Camera stays completely still.
caption: sit down. you're blocking my view 🖤 #penthouse #latina #nightout
